name: Ultrawide layouts
author: Vasiliy Kirochka
description: Switch the focused workspace between Hyprland layout presets built for ultrawide panels, and resize the master column, from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: One bar icon showing the focused workspace's layout preset. Left = pick a preset, right = next, middle = snap back, scroll = resize the master column.

schema.label: Show the preset name next to the icon
Scroll step for the master column
schema.description: How much one scroll notch grows or shrinks the master window, as a fraction of the screen width.
